cards.ex: I had to get my brother to help me move the furniture; he wasn't happy about it.
cards.exUz: Men akamni mebelni ko'chirishga yordam berishga majbur qildim; u bundan xursand emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir biror ishni bajarishga ko'ndirish yoki majburlash.

cards.ex: I was just about to leave when the phone rang.
cards.exUz: Men ketmoqchi bo'lib turgandim, telefon jiringladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa yaqinda, shu zahoti sodir bo'lishi.

cards.ex: She makes a point of calling her grandmother every Sunday.
cards.exUz: U har yakshanba buvisiga qo'ng'iroq qilishni qasd qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni doimiy ravishda, qasd bilan bajarish.

cards.ex: I've come to realize that happiness is more important than money.
cards.exUz: Men baxt puldan muhimroq ekanligini anglab yetdim.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan biror narsani tushunib yetish.

cards.ex: I can't stand doing the dishes after a big meal.
cards.exUz: Katta ovqatdan keyin idishlarni yuvishni mutlaqo yoqtirmayman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishni mutlaqo yoqtirmaslik, nafratlanish.

cards.ex: She's very keen on learning how to play the guitar.
cards.exUz: U gitara chalishni o'rganishga juda qiziqadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishga katta qiziqishi bo'lish.

cards.ex: We went out for a drink and ended up dancing all night.
cards.exUz: Biz ichish uchun chiqdik va oxiri tun bo'yi raqsga tushdik.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilmagan holda biror narsani qilish bilan yakunlash.

cards.ex: There's no point in arguing with him; he never listens.
cards.exUz: U bilan bahslashishdan foyda yo'q; u hech qachon eshitmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishdan hech qanday ma'no yo'qligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: With that kind of attitude, he's bound to fail.
cards.exUz: Bunday munosabat bilan, u albatta muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa aniq sodir bo'lishini bildiradi.

cards.ex: I feel like going for a walk in the park.
cards.exUz: Men parkda sayr qilishni xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishni xohlamoq, istamoq.

cards.ex: I finally got around to cleaning the garage this weekend.
cards.exUz: Men nihoyat shu hafta oxirida garajni tozalashga vaqt topdim.
cards.uzDef: Oxiri biror ishni bajarish uchun vaqt topmoq.

cards.ex: I'm used to waking up early because of my job.
cards.exUz: Men ishim tufayli erta turishga o'rganib qolganman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga odatlanib qolgan bo'lish.

cards.ex: Don't hesitate to ask if you need any help.
cards.exUz: Agar yordam kerak bo'lsa, so'rashga ikkilanmang.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishga ikkilanish, qat'iy bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: My parents always made me do my homework before watching TV.
cards.exUz: Ota-onam har doim televizor ko'rishdan oldin uy vazifalarini qildirishardi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir biror ishni qilishga majburlash, ruxsat berish.

cards.ex: I happened to see her at the grocery store yesterday.
cards.exUz: Men uni kecha oziq-ovqat do'konida tasodifan ko'rdim.
cards.uzDef: Tasodifan biror narsa sodir bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The students are eager to learn new things.
cards.exUz: Talabalar yangi narsalarni o'rganishga intilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishga juda xohishi bo'lish, intilish.

cards.ex: It's worth investing in your education; it will pay off in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish arziydi; bu uzoq muddatda o'z samarasini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilish arziydiganligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: I can't help but laugh when he tells his silly jokes.
cards.exUz: U ahmoqona hazillarini aytganda, men kulmasdan turolmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilmaslikka imkon yo'qligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: We're supposed to meet at 7 pm for dinner.
cards.exUz: Biz kechki ovqat uchun soat 7 da uchrashishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilish kerakligi yoki kutilayotganligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: He admitted to stealing the money.
cards.exUz: U pul o'g'irlaganini tan oldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilganini tan olmoq.

cards.ex: I object to paying such high taxes.
cards.exUz: Men bunday yuqori soliq to'lashga qarshiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishga qarshi ekanligini bildirish.

cards.ex: Stress can lead to eating unhealthy food.
cards.exUz: Stress nosog'lom ovqatlar iste'mol qilishga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror ish boshqa ishning sodir bo'lishiga sabab bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm open to trying new things.
cards.exUz: Men yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rishga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishga tayyor, rozi bo'lish.

cards.ex: Education is vital to a successful future.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim muvaffaqiyatli kelajak uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa juda muhim ekanligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: She devoted her life to helping the poor.
cards.exUz: U hayotini kambag'allarga yordam berishga bag'ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt, energiya va resurslarni biror ishga bag'ishlamoq.

cards.ex: I'm really looking forward to seeing you again.
cards.exUz: Men sizni yana ko'rishni chin dildan intizorlik bilan kutyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani sodir bo'lishini katta umid bilan kutish.

cards.ex: I have difficulty understanding his accent.
cards.exUz: Men uning shevasini tushunishda qiynalaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishda qiyinchiliklarga duch kelmoq.

cards.ex: He owes his success to working hard.
cards.exUz: U o'z muvaffaqiyatiga qattiq mehnat qilish tufayli qarzdor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sababi boshqa narsa ekanligini aytish.

cards.ex: She's prone to getting colds in the winter.
cards.exUz: U qishda shamollashga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa sodir bo'lish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lish.

cards.ex: I need to study hard in order to pass the exam.
cards.exUz: Imtihondan o'tish uchun men qattiq o'qishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga erishish uchun.
